original_report: daily schedule leaves out the final numbered day in a closed interval.
diagnosis: range has an exclusive stop; increment the terminal boundary.
patch_diff:
--- a/target.py
+++ b/target.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def scheduled_days(begin, finish):
-    days = range(begin, finish)
+    days = range(begin, finish + 1)
     return list(days)
